name: Bandersnatch Interactive
description: Injects Netflix-accurate interactive choice UI directly into the native Jellyfin player for Black Mirror: Bandersnatch. Auto-detects the interactive cut, shows choice overlays with countdown timer, and handles seek navigation intelligently.
overview: Play Black Mirror: Bandersnatch the way it was meant to be experienced. Choice buttons injected into Jellyfin's native player — no separate player page needed.

versions.changelog: Initial release — complete interactive choice overlay built on the native Jellyfin player.
